scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请站住！
您携带的物品过多，背包空间不足，无法领取奖励。
请腾出一些背包空间后再来接受挑战。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Greetings...
My name is Sir Chilias'Tyus.
I've lived a long time here in
Rune-Midgarts and I've come
to see and know a lot of things. Power, jealously, hardship...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
你好...我是奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士。
我在卢恩·米德加兹生活了很久，见证并经历了许多事情。
力量、嫉妒、苦难...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what exactly
brings you here to
the middle of Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，究竟是什么把你带到梦罗克的中心呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
This land has grown corrupt
with the diseases of greed
and selfishness. Everywhere
you go, people are heartless,
but I still believe that I'll find the one worthy enough to help me...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
这片土地已被贪婪和自私所腐蚀。无论走到哪里，人们都冷酷无情。但我仍相信，终会找到一位值得托付、愿意帮助我的人...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
There is no shortage of
brave and strong warriors
in these dangerous times.
But for the thing I seek,
I must have the help of one
who is truly pure of heart...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
在这动荡的时代，从不缺勇敢强壮的战士。但我要寻找的东西，必须由一位真正心地纯洁的人来帮忙...

scripts.text: What are you looking for?
scripts.translation: 你在寻找什么？

scripts.text: Pure of heart? Hah! Good luck!
scripts.translation: 内心纯洁？哈！祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Heh heh~ I see your eyes
glimmer with enthusiasm,
but it seems this task might
be a little too much for you.
I'm sorry, but that's the
reality I can't ignore...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
嘿嘿~ 我看到你眼中闪烁着热情，但这任务对你来说可能有点太难了。
很抱歉，这是我无法忽视的现实...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Go out in to the world,
and grow in strength.
Perhaps after you become
more capable, I'll find that
I can rely on your help.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
去外面的世界历练吧，变得更强。
也许等你变得更有能力后，我会发现可以依靠你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I suppose I should tell you
first about my grandfather,
who was once a young and
feareless adventurer, much
like yourself. Yes, he traveled the world with his three friends...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我想，我该先说说祖父的故事。他曾是个年轻无畏的冒险者，和你很像。他与三位好友一同游历世界...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
The four of them went on
many expeditions together
and earned themselves a
reputation as a courageous
team that worked especially
well together after many years.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
他们四人一起进行了许多探险，并凭借多年默契的配合，赢得了勇敢团队的美名。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Then, on what was supposed
to be a typical journey, they found an uncharted cave. Curious, and
in need of rest, the four ventured inside. There, they encountered
that most horrible creature...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
然后，在一次看似普通的旅途中，他们发现了一个未标记的洞穴。
出于好奇，又需要休息，四人便走了进去。
在那里，他们遇到了那个最可怕的生物...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
It was a ferocious beast
with horns as large and as
sharp as their weapons, with
eyes that blazed with hellfire.
My grandfather could tell that
it was thirsty for blood.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
那是一头凶猛的野兽，长着像武器一样巨大且锋利的角，双眼燃烧着地狱之火。
我祖父能感觉到，它渴望鲜血。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
They ran from the beast
as quickly as they could,
but the four were separated
in the cave's darkness. It was
all they could do to hide in
the darkness of the cave...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
他们拼命逃离野兽，但在洞穴的黑暗中，四人走散了。
他们只能躲在洞穴的黑暗角落里...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
From his hiding place, my
grandfather heard the screams
of his friends as the monster
slaughtered them, one by one.
The screams and the monster's
growls were getting closer...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
从藏身处，我祖父听到了朋友们被魔物一个个屠杀的尖叫声。
尖叫声和魔物的咆哮声越来越近...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Unable to endure the
suffering of his trusted
comrades, my grandfather
jumped out hiding and tried
to save his friends. The beast
found him and they battled.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
祖父不忍看着挚友受苦，便从藏身处冲了出来，试图救他们。野兽发现了他，两者随即展开搏斗。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
It was no use. The beast
was too powerful and my
grandfather was knocked out.
When he came to, his friends
were all dead and a shining
gem lay in a pool of blood.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
毫无用处。
野兽太强大了，我祖父被打晕了过去。
当他醒来时，朋友们都已死去，一滩血泊中躺着一颗发光的宝石。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
My grandfather buried
his friends that day. He
took that gem as a memento
of their final expedition, but
wondered why the beast
had decided to spare him.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
祖父当天埋葬了朋友们。他带走那颗宝石，作为他们最后一次探险的纪念，却始终想不明白野兽为什么放过了他。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
It wasn't long before he
experienced the gem's curse
firsthand. The gem inexplicably
drew people to it, taking the
greed in their hearts and
twisting their minds...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
没过多久，他就亲身体验了宝石的诅咒。
宝石莫名其妙地吸引人们靠近，利用他们心中的贪婪扭曲他们的思想...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Grandfather believed the
beast let him live so that
the gem would be set loose
upon the outside world, free
to pollute it with its evil. He had to do something...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
祖父认为，野兽让他活着，是为了让宝石流入外界，自由地用邪恶污染世界。
他必须做点什么...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
However, the gem proved
to be formed out of pure evil
and could not be destroyed
by human means. In the end,
my grandfather hid the gem
someplace safe...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
然而，海利翁之眼是由纯粹的邪恶凝聚而成，无法凭人力摧毁。最终，我的祖父把它藏在了一个安全的地方...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
However, the threat of the
gem still exists. Grandfather
and my father worked for years to find a way to seal its darkness.
Only now have I been able to create a bracelet to seal its evil power.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
不过，宝石的威胁依然存在。祖父和父亲多年来一直在寻找封印其黑暗力量的方法。直到如今，我才终于制成一只能够封印它邪恶力量的手镯。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
For my grandfather and his
friends to truly rest in peace,
I must find an adventurer of
pure heart who can find the
gem and bring it to me so that
I can finally seal its power.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
为了让祖父和他的朋友们真正安息，我必须找到一位心地纯洁的冒险者，请他找到海利翁之眼并带给我，好让我彻底封印它的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I think... I think you
might be the hero that
I've been waiting for. Will
you help an old man for the
sake of all that is good?
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我想...我想你或许就是我一直等待的英雄。为了世间一切美好，你愿意帮帮我这个老人吗？

scripts.text: Of course, I will.
scripts.translation: 当然，我愿意

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I can't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我做不到

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Good, good, but first
I must test to see if you
are worthy of holding the
Hellion's gem. I can't tell
you exactly where it is, but
I will give you some clues.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
很好，很好。不过首先，我得测试你是否有资格持有海利翁之眼。我不能告诉你它的确切位置，但可以给你一些线索。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
First, speak to Clanux
Heffron in Prontera. He
has offered to help me find
the gem, but I do not know if
I can trust him. Please help me protect this world from the gem...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
首先，去普隆德拉找克拉努克斯·赫夫伦。他说愿意帮我找宝石，但我不知道能不能信任他。请帮我保护这个世界，免受宝石的威胁...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I understand...
I know I am asking much
of you, and this task is not
one to take lightly. However,
I believe that you are wholly
capable of accomplishing this.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我理解...我知道这对你要求很高，这项任务也不容轻视。不过，我相信你完全有能力完成它。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Times are bad when
even the youth have
been jaded. But I refuse
to believe that hope is
truly lost in this age...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
世道艰难，连年轻人都变得麻木了。但我不愿相信这个时代已经彻底失去希望...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Please seek out
Clanux Heffron in
Prontera. He may have
information regarding a
clue leading to the Hellion
gem. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
请去普隆德拉找克拉努克斯·赫夫伦。他或许掌握着通往海利翁之眼的线索。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
So have you considered
my proposal? I believe that
you may be the one who will
help me in sealing away the
Hellion gem's evil forever.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
你考虑过我的提议了吗？我相信你或许就是能帮我永远封印海利翁之眼邪恶力量的人。

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我会帮你。

scripts.text: ...Sorry about that.
scripts.translation: ...抱歉

I must test to see if you
are worthy of holding the

I believe that you are wholly
capable of accomplishing this.
scripts.translation:

我理解...我知道这对您要求很高，这项任务也不容轻视。
然而，我相信您完全有能力完成它。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Try to see what you can
learn from Clanux Heffron.
I don't know how cooperative
he will be, but I'm sure that
he'll tell you something one
way or another.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
试着从克拉努克斯·赫夫伦那里打听一下。
我不知道他会配合到什么程度，但我相信无论如何他都会透露一些信息的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Ah, yes! This is one piece
of the tablet that will lead
you to the Hellion's gem!
This engraving was definitely
made by my grandfather, and Christopher was one of his friends.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
啊，没错！这是指引你找到海利翁之眼的石板碎片之一！上面的刻字肯定是祖父留下的，而克里斯托弗正是他的朋友之一。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I suppose he hid these pieces
in the places that reminded him
of his friends. Now according
to the tablet's message, you
should find the next piece in ''the city of thickest forest.''
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我想，祖父把这些碎片藏在了让他想起朋友的地方。根据石板上的信息，你应该在“森林最茂密的城市”找到下一块碎片。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I'm sure that the
next tablet piece is
in Payon, so go there
and see if you can find
it. Good luck to you,
kind adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我确信下一块石板碎片在斐扬，去那里找找看吧。祝你好运，善良的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Now that I think about
it, there's a guy in Payon
that I know named Grout'the
Tuccok who knew my grandfather.
He might know something, but
he's a little, well... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
仔细想想，斐扬有个叫格鲁特·图科克的人认识我的祖父。他可能知道些什么，不过他有点...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I think you're doing
a good job in finding
those clues in Payon.
Please do your best in
finding the rest of the
pieces of that tablet.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我觉得你在斐扬寻找线索做得很好。请继续努力，找到石板剩下的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
While you were gone,
I felt a little bad that you
were searching for the
tablets pieces on your own,
so I managed to find this
piece here in Morocc. But...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
你离开后，我有些过意不去，便也去寻找石板碎片，并在梦罗克找到了这一块。不过...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Why are they glowing like
this? In any case, we have
this piece I found here in
Morocc, and the pieces you
found in Prontera and Payon. There's one more left in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
它们为什么会这样发光？总之，我们有我在梦罗克找到的这一块，还有你在普隆德拉和斐扬找到的碎片。吉芬还剩下最后一块。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Anyway, on the tablet
piece that I found, it
says ''Hakim loved magic,
and always enjoyed its
wondrous city,'' so I'm sure
the last piece is in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我找到的这块石板碎片上写着：“哈基姆热爱魔法，总是喜欢那座奇妙的城市。”所以我确信，最后一块碎片在吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Please, take this third
tablet piece and find the
final piece so that we can
fulfill my dear grandfather's
greatest wish and forever
seal away the Hellion's gem.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
请带上这第三块石板碎片，再找到最后一块。如此一来，我们就能实现祖父毕生最大的愿望，永远封印海利翁之眼。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
When you get to Geffen,
please speak to Welshyun,
who's been helping me in
creating a device to seal the
gem's darkness. He is worthy of trust and will surely help us.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
到了吉芬后，请去找威尔什云。他一直在帮我制作封印宝石黑暗力量的装置，是个值得信任的人，一定会帮我们的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Where are the tablet pieces?
Have you hoarded them away
to steal the Hellion's gem
for yourself?! I must smite
you now before you are
consumed by its darkness!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
石板碎片在哪儿？你把它们藏起来，想独吞海利翁之眼吗？！在你被它的黑暗吞噬之前，我必须先制伏你！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Please visit the
sage named Welshyun
in Geffen. We are good
friends, so I am sure
that you can trust him.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
请去吉芬拜访名叫威尔什云的贤者。他是我的好友，你可以信任他。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
You have all four
pieces of the tablet?
That's great news! Ah,
and the gem is embedded
in each of the tablet pieces.
We're so close to finishing!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
你集齐了四块石板碎片？太好了！啊，而且宝石镶在每一块碎片上。我们就快完成了！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Ah, would you go back
to Welshyun? I know it's
a hassle, but he is probably
the only one who can combine
the tablet pieces into the its
complete form. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
啊，能麻烦你再去找威尔什云一趟吗？我知道这很麻烦，但他大概是唯一能把石板碎片拼成完整石板的人。谢谢你...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Where are the tablet pieces?
Have you hoarded them away
to steal the Hellion's gem
for yourself?! I must smite
you now before you are
consumed by its darkness!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
石板碎片在哪儿？你把它们藏起来，想独吞海利翁之眼吗？！在你被黑暗吞噬前，我必须先制伏你！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Ah, would you go back
to Welshyun? I know it's
a hassle, but he is probably
the only one who can combine
the tablet pieces into the its
complete form. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
啊，能麻烦你再去找威尔什云一趟吗？我知道这很麻烦，但他大概是唯一能把石板碎片拼成完整石板的人。谢谢你...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
At long last. We have
everything. The Tablet
and the Hellion's gem.
Now I can finally use
this bracelet to seal
its power forever...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
终于，我们集齐了一切：石板和海利翁之眼。现在我终于可以用这只手镯永远封印它的力量了...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
But your eyes...
They seem so tired
and I can sense some
sort of pain from them.
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
可是你的眼神...看起来疲惫不堪，我还能从中感觉到一丝痛苦。发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I learned the secret of
the Hellion's gem. It...
It turns people into
Hellion Revenants.
It's what happened
to your grandfather...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得知了海利翁之眼的秘密。它...它会把人变成暗黑祭司。你的祖父当年就是这样...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
What...
What did you just say?
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
什么...你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The tablet had a map that
let me to the chamber where
your grandfather locked himself
up before he completed turned
into the Hellion Revenant.
It was horrible...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
石板上的地图指引我找到了你祖父的密室。他在彻底变成暗黑祭司之前，把自己锁在了那里。那景象太可怕了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
At the entrance, he
left a message that said
that he wanted to be killed.
So that he could finally join
his friends instead of living
as a monster. So I... So I...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
入口处留着一条信息，说他希望有人杀了他。这样他就能与朋友们团聚，而不必作为怪物活下去。所以我...所以我...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
It's okay. I know you
did the right thing. It's
what my grandfather
would have wanted most.
Thank you for finally freeing
his soul and giving him peace.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
没关系，我知道你做得对。这正是祖父最希望看到的。谢谢你终于解脱了他的灵魂，让他得以安息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here, I think you
should have this Eye
of Hellion, in case you
wanted a memento of
your dear grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你，我想你应该收下这只海利翁之眼，作为你亲爱祖父的纪念。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I'd appreciate that.
Grandfather's eye...
It's full of the painful
experiences of the people
who were turned into Hellion
Revenants against their will.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我很感激。祖父的眼睛...里面充满了那些被迫变成暗黑祭司之人的痛苦经历。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
But... Now is not the
time for sentiment. For
the sake of my grandfather,
I must seal the power of
the Hellion's gem now!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
但是...现在不是感伤的时候。
为了我祖父，我必须现在封印海利翁之眼的力量！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Darkness that writhes,
souls lost in the inferno,
I offer you comfort, I offer
you peace. To the despairing
ones, to the shameless ones,
I give guidance to heaven...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
在炼狱中挣扎的黑暗、迷失的灵魂啊，我赐予你们慰藉与安宁。绝望者、无耻者啊，我指引你们前往天堂...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Instead of sadness,
let there be joy. Instead
of anger, let there be
love. Souls that are
lost will now find
their way...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
愿悲伤化为喜悦，愿愤怒化为爱。迷失的灵魂啊，如今找到归途吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Light and hope...
Heaven and earth...
Cast away the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
光明与希望...天与地...驱散黑暗吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I did it.
After all these
long years, I finally did
it. Thanks to your help.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
我做到了。
历经漫长岁月，我终于做到了。
多亏了你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Please take this
Nile Rose, which will
keep the power of the gem
in check. I trust that you will
keep its secret and protect it
from those motivated by greed.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
请收下这朵尼罗玫瑰，它能压制宝石的力量。我相信你会保守这个秘密，并保护它免受贪婪之人的觊觎。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Thank you, kind
adventurer, for bringing
peace to my grandfather's
soul and for working to
protect peace in our world.
You are the truest of heroes.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
谢谢你，善良的冒险者。你让祖父的灵魂得以安息，也帮助守护了我们世界的和平。你才是真正的英雄。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have received the
Nile Rose in which the
Hellion's gem is sealed.
The Eye of the Hellion has
granted you some experience
through its strange powers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你获得了封印着海利翁之眼的尼罗玫瑰。海利翁之眼以其奇异的力量赐予你一些经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
At long last. We have
everything. The Tablet
and the Hellion's gem.
Now I can finally use
this bracelet to seal
its power forever...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
终于，我们集齐了一切：石板和海利翁之眼。现在我终于可以用这只手镯永远封印它的力量了...

Cast away the darkness.

soul and for working to

You are the truest of heroes.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
谢谢你，善良的冒险者，你让我祖父的灵魂得以安息，并致力于守护世界的和平。
你才是真正的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Where is the complete
tablet? We need that in
order to extract the Hellion's
gem in order to seal its power!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
完整的石板在哪里？我们需要它取出海利翁之眼，才能封印它的力量！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Long time no see. So, are you doing well to keep the promise with me?
Please handle it with care
to prevent the evil power within from being released.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
好久不见。你还记得并遵守对我的承诺吗？
请小心保管，别让其中的邪恶力量释放出来。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
You still have the Hellion's Eye.
I can see the pain in your eyes.
Let me lighten your burden. It will be better this way.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
你还拿着海利翁之眼。我能看出你眼中的痛苦。让我替你减轻负担吧，这样对大家都好。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
May God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
愿上帝保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Long time no see. So, are you doing well to keep the promise with me?
Please handle it with care
to prevent the evil power within from being released.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
好久不见。
那么，你遵守与我的约定了吗？
请小心保管，防止其中的邪恶力量被释放。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
... ... ...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士]
...

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne of the Tablet Pieces
that you have is beginning to
shine with light, as if it were
responding to something...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你持有的一块石板碎片开始发出光芒，仿佛在对某物做出回应...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请站住！
您携带的物品过多，背包空间不足，无法领取奖励。
请腾出一些背包空间后再来接受挑战。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
What's wrong with
this map?! I can't
find a blasted thing
on it! How can finding
something be so hard?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
这张地图怎么了？！
我什么都找不到！
找东西怎么这么难？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but are
you Clanux Heffron?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，请问你是克拉努克斯·赫夫伦吗？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Why, who are you
and what the heck
do you want? Oh...
Sent by Chilias, eh?
What does he want?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
啊，你是谁，想干什么？
哦...是奇利亚斯派你来的？
他有什么事？

scripts.text: He wants me to help you.
scripts.translation: 他想让我帮你。

scripts.text: He wants you to help me.
scripts.translation: 他想让你帮我。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
So he sent me an
assistant, huh? Well...
Seeing as he gave me this
clue and I've taken so long
and still don't have anything to show for it, I don't blame him.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
原来他给我派了个助手啊？好吧...既然他给了我线索，而我花了这么久却毫无进展，我也不能怪他。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Well, if he sent you to
help me out, I guess I can
tell you everything. For the
clues he had me look for,
I've only found two so far.
But I can't figure them out...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
好吧，既然他派你来帮我，我想我可以把一切都告诉你。
关于他让我寻找的线索，我目前只找到了两个。
但我搞不懂它们的意思...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Let's see, there's this
broken sword and this
strange lookin' cogwheel.
What do these clues mean?!
Did the old man give you
any hints to help me out?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
让我看看，有一把断剑和一个奇怪的齿轮。这些线索是什么意思？！那个老头有没有给你什么提示？

scripts.text: Where did you find these?
scripts.translation: 你在哪里找到的？

scripts.text: No, I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 不，对不起。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh, these I found in Prontera.
That old coot hid these real
good. But yeah, I doubt you'd
find anything, but would you try
checking out the old Swordman
Training ground for more clues?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
哦，这些是我在普隆德拉找到的。那个老家伙把它们藏得真够严实。不过我觉得你大概也找不到什么，但要不要去旧剑士训练场看看有没有别的线索？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Man, that Hellion's gem
must really be worth a pretty
penny if the old man went
through so much trouble to
even hide these clues. Oh
man, I want it so bad...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
天哪，如果那个老头费了这么大劲去藏这些线索，那海利翁之眼一定价值连城吧。
唉，我好想要它啊...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Wha--? Then why are
you even here to help
me then? Huh. That old
coot must not trust me
enough, but I can't exactly
blame him. Alright then...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
什么——？那你来帮我干什么？哼，那个老家伙肯定不够信任我，不过我也不能怪他。好吧...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
If you're gonna help me,
go search the old Swordman
Training Grounds over here in
Prontera. I doubt it, but there's
a chance I mighta missed
something there. Get to it!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
如果你要帮我，就去普隆德拉这边的旧剑士训练场找找。虽然我觉得不太可能，但我可能在那里漏掉了什么。快去！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Help you...? What, with
clues to the location of
the Hellion's gem? Screw
that, pal! Why should I help
you if we're gonna compete
for the same prize?!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
帮你...？帮你找海利翁之眼的线索？得了吧，伙计！既然我们要争同一件宝物，我凭什么帮你？！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey, why do you keep
botherin' me?! Go and
find your own clues for the
Hellion's gem on your own,
jerkface! Now getouttahere!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
嘿，你为什么老是缠着我？！
自己去找海利翁之眼的线索吧，你这个讨厌鬼！
现在给我滚！

scripts.text: W-wait! Let's work together!
scripts.translation: 等等！我们要合作！

scripts.text: Fine. I don't need your help!
scripts.translation: 好吧。我不需要你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Work together, eh? You
know, normally I'd tell you
to make like a moonwalker
and just beat it, but I gotta
admit that I ain't doin' so
good on my own on this...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
合作，是吗？平时我会让你像跳太空步那样赶紧滚蛋，不过我得承认，这事我自己一个人确实没什么进展...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Alright, fine.
First, look through
the old Swordman Training
Grounds here in Prontera.
There might be some clues left over there for you to find...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
好吧，行吧。
首先，去查查普隆德拉这边的旧剑士训练场。
那里可能还剩下一些线索供你发现...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine.
I don't need
your help!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
我不需要你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Clannux Heffron]
Yeah right!
You'll be back!
...They always
come back.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
没错！
你迟早会回来！
...他们总会回来的。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Look pal, I found this broken
sword, a bonafide clue if I ever saw one, in the old Swordman
Training Grounds in Prontera.
You should be able to find
something else there... maybe.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
听着，伙计，我在普隆德拉的旧剑士训练场找到了这把破裂之剑，这可是个货真价实的线索。
你应该也能在那里找到点别的...也许吧。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey, you're done
searching? Were you
able to find anything?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
嘿，你搜完了？
你找到什么了吗？

scripts.text: Nothing...
scripts.translation: 什么也没找到

scripts.text: In fact, I found this.
scripts.translation: 实际上，我找到了这个

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(This guy's a real punk!
I better not share any new
information I've found, just
in case he doesn't already
know about it.)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333（这家伙真是个混蛋！为了保险起见，我最好别把新发现告诉他，免得他还不知道。）^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I... I wasn't able to
find anything that looked
like a clue. I'm sorry, but
I let you down big time...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...我没能找到任何看起来像线索的东西。
对不起，我让你失望了...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Aw nuts! Alright, if you
go back to the old man, let
him know that I found a broken
sword from the old Swordman
Training Grounds and this
cogwheel from the Tool Shop.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
该死！好吧，如果你回去找那个老人，告诉他我在旧剑士训练场找到了一把断剑，还在工具店找到一个齿轮。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
The clues I've found so
far don't make any sense!
So if you can, convince him to
drop me a couple more hints.
And give this to the old guy
to prove I found it, will you?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
我找到的线索完全讲不通！如果可以，帮忙说服他再给我几个提示。还有，把这个交给那老头，证明是我找到的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
That's all I know.
At this point you're
probably better off
searching for these
clues on your own...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
我就知道这么多。
到现在为止，你最好还是自己去搜寻这些线索...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
So that's what you
found? Huh. I'm even
more confused. Alright.
Well, I found a broken
sword in the Swordman
Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
所以这就是你找到的东西？嗯，我更糊涂了。好吧，我在剑士训练场也找到了一把断剑。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh, and I also found
this old cogwheel in the
Tool Shop around here.
Here, just take it. Maybe
you'll have better luck
figuring out what it means.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
哦，我还在附近的工具店找到这个旧齿轮。拿去吧，也许你比我更能弄明白它的意思。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
But once you do
learn anything new,
to me and let me know!
That's an order, got it?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
你要是发现了什么新线索，就告诉我！这是命令，听见没有？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey... Didn't I tell
you to check out the
Tool Shop in case there
was anything I missed?
Now go! That's an order!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
嘿...我不是让你去查查工具店，看看有没有我漏掉的东西吗？
现在快去！
这是命令！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Wha--? I had no idea
that sort of thing could
be hidden in that training
I missed it. Oh, so the Veggie Lady gave you a password and all?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
什——？我完全没想到训练场里竟藏着那种东西，真是走眼了。哦，所以卖菜女士还给了你密码？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Huh, I can't make heads
or tails of that password.
I guess I have no choice but
to give you this, the cogwheel clue I found from the Tool Shop.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
嗯，我完全搞不懂那个密码。看来我只能把这个给你了，就是我在工具店找到的齿轮线索。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
I mean, you've been lucky
enough till now, so you'll
probably be able to stumble
upon the answer behind this
weird, weird riddle. But you
gotta tell me the answer too!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
我是说，你到目前为止运气不错，应该能碰巧解开这个古怪的谜题。不过，答案也得告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Alright, now take your
cogwheel and get outta
here. The sooner you get
that clue, the sooner I'll
get that Hellion's gem.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
好了，拿着齿轮，快出去。你越快找到线索，我就越快拿到海利翁之眼。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey, hurry up and check
the Tool Shop and figure
out the meaning of that
password! Maybe that weird
machine there is a part of
this whole puzzle? Nah...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
嘿，快去查查工具店，弄清楚那个密码的意思！也许那台奇怪的机器就是整个谜题的一部分？不...不会吧...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey...
Didja find anything
new in the Tool Shop?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
嘿...你在工具店发现什么新东西了吗？

scripts.text: Pretend that nothing happened.
scripts.translation: 假装什么都没发生

scripts.text: Share what you learned.
scripts.translation: 分享你学到的东西

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nope...
I couldn't find any
new leads. I guess
I have no choice but to
go back to Chilias'Tyus,
unless you know anything...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有...我没找到任何新线索。看来我只能回去找奇利亚斯·提乌斯了，除非你知道些什么...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Bah!
Freakin' useless!
What kind of assistant
are you anyway, huh?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
呸！真没用！你到底算哪门子助手？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I put that cogwheel
into that weird machine in
the Tool Shop and some kind
of number pad came out. Then...
Uh, I couldn't figure out what
the password was. I'm stuck!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我把那个齿轮放进了工具店那个奇怪的机器里，然后弹出了一个数字键盘。
然后...呃，我搞不懂密码是什么。
我卡住了！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh yeah? Hah! Well, now
that the easy part is done, I'll just figure out that secret
password myself! Hahaha! That Hellion's gem is as good as mine!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
哦，是吗？哈！既然简单的部分已经完成，接下来我就自己破解那个秘密密码！哈哈哈！海利翁之眼已经是我的囊中之物了！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey, so you have
anything new to report?
Oh, and did you learn
anything from that weird
machine in the Tool Shop?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
嘿，所以你有什么新消息要报告吗？
哦，还有，你从工具店那个奇怪的机器里学到了什么吗？

scripts.text: Tell him just a little bit.
scripts.translation: 告诉他一点点

scripts.text: Don't tell him.
scripts.translation: 不告诉他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I put that cogwheel
into that weird machine in
the Tool Shop and some kind
of number pad came out. Then...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把那个齿轮放进工具店那台奇怪的机器里，然后弹出了一个数字键盘。接着...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(Wait, I can't trust this
guy!)^000000 I put in every single
password that I could think
of, but nothing happened!
I think I'm stuck...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333（等等，我不能相信这家伙！）^000000我把能想到的密码都试了一遍，可什么也没发生！我想我卡住了...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh yeah? Hah! Well, now
that the easy part is done, I'll just figure out that secret
password myself! Hahaha! That Hellion's gem is as good as mine!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
哦，是吗？哈！既然简单的部分已经完成，接下来我就自己破解那个秘密密码！哈哈哈！海利翁之眼马上就是我的了！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Huh. You should be able
to get some number pad to
come out from that machine.
Yeah, I was able to get that
far, but I haven't been able
to figure out the password...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
嗯。
你应该能从那个机器里弄出一个数字键盘。
对，我也做到了这一步，但我还没能解开密码...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh hey, it's you.
Listen I got this number
pad to pop out of that old
machine in the Tool Shop,
I still don't know what the
password for it might be.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
哦，是你啊。
听着，我从工具店那个旧机器里弄出了一个数字键盘，但我还是不知道密码可能是什么。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
If I couldn't figure
it out, and I understand
if you couldn't figure this
out, then this puzzle must
be freakin' impossible!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
如果连我都解不开，我也理解你可能搞不定。那这谜题肯定难得要命！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh man, I am totally
lost. What the heck
should I be looking for?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫伦]
天哪，我完全迷失了。
我到底该找什么？

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a training dummy
with a gash in its body
that looks like it was made
by the thrust of a sharp sword.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一个训练假人，身上有一道裂口，看起来像是被锋利的剑刺穿的。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Didn't Clanux mention that he
found a broken sword around
here? Maybe this was exactly
where he found it. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
克拉努克斯不是说他在附近发现了一把断剑吗？也许这里就是他找到断剑的地方。让我看看...

scripts.text: Inspect the dummy's gash
scripts.translation: 检查假人的裂口

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside of the dummy's body is
a steel bearing with a roughly
etched message that reads:^000000
^4d4dff''Veggie Lady N9 W3 BINGO.''^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF假人身体里有个钢制轴承，上面潦草地刻着一行字：^000000
^4d4dff“卖菜的女士 N9 W3 BINGO。”^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the heck does this
even mean? A Veggie Lady?
Does Clanux know anything
at all about this clue...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这到底是什么意思？卖菜的女士？克拉努克斯到底知不知道这个线索...？

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a training dummy
that was used to hone the
skills of new Swordmen...
But the Swordman Training
Grounds have moved to Izlude.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一个用来磨练新晋剑士技艺的训练假人...不过，剑士训练场已经搬到依斯鲁得岛了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, according to the
message in that old training
dummy, this is where I'm
supposed to go. Nine steps
north, 3 steps west. And now...
Veggie Lady. Okay, okay...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，根据那个旧训练假人里的信息，我应该去那儿。向北九步，再向西三步。然后...卖菜的女士。好，好...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh. That's creepy.
There's one right there
staring at me. But after
the words ''Veggie Lady,''
all the message says is, um,
what was that last word again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，真吓人。那里有个卖菜的女士正盯着我。不过，“卖菜的女士”后面写的是什么来着？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course!
''BINGO!'' But
I don't see a hall
full of old people
around here, I--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然！
“BINGO！”不过我可没看到附近有坐满老人的大厅，我——

scripts.text:
[Veggie Lady]
Finally, you say it.
Yeesh, I thought I was
going to wait forever for
somebody to say that
password. Okay, here's
the code number you want...
scripts.translation:
[卖菜的女士]
终于有人说出那个词了。哎呀，我还以为要等到天荒地老呢。好了，这是你要的密码...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
C-code number?
Wait, wh-what...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
代、代码数字？
等等，什、什么...？

scripts.text:
[Veggie Lady]
Awww...I don't know!
I'm only gonna say it
now:^4D4DFF 3847147298^000000. One
more time, in case you
didn't get it:^4D4DFF 3847147298^000000.
Don't forget it, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卖菜的女士]
哎呀...我也不知道！我现在只说一次：^4D4DFF 3847147298^000000。再说一次，以防你没听清：^4D4DFF 3847147298^000000。别忘了，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait... What does
this all mean? Won't
you tell me more?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...这到底是什么意思？
你就不肯多告诉我一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Veggie Lady]
No. I've been given
explicit instructions
to not tell you more.
In fact, I hate talking.
That's why I sell vegetables.
scripts.translation:
[卖菜的女士]
不行。有人明确吩咐过，不能再告诉你更多。其实，我讨厌说话，所以才来卖菜。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Holy cow...
This is all
really cloak and
dagger type stuff!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...这整件事也太神神秘秘、鬼鬼祟祟了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
{1}!
Hmmm. No, no that couldn't
be it. What in the world was that word and why can't I remember it
when I seemingly need it most?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
{1}！
嗯...不，不可能是那个。那个词到底是什么？为什么偏偏在我最需要它的时候想不起来？

scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请站住！
您携带的物品过多，背包空间不足，无法领取奖励。
请腾出一些背包空间后再来接受挑战。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a weird looking
machine that looks like
it hasn't been used in a
while. It looks like the
cogwheel that you have
would fit perfectly in it...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一台外观奇怪的机器，似乎已经很久没使用过了。你手里的齿轮看起来正好能装进去...^000000

scripts.text: Insert Cogwheel.
scripts.translation: 插入齿轮

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I just know this
cogwheel will fit
into this machine!
What I don't know is
what will happen once
this machine works...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我就知道这个齿轮能装进这台机器！可我不知道机器启动后会发生什么...

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Click...!*
Once the cogwheel is
fit into the machine and
turned, the device hums
to life and a panel opens,
revealing a numeric keypad.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔哒...!*
齿轮装入机器并转动后，装置嗡的一声启动，面板随即打开，露出数字键盘。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess that I've got
to input some kind of
numeric password...
Ah, right, the numbers
that Veggie Lady gave me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来我得输入某种数字密码...啊，对了，就是卖菜的女士给我的那些数字！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe machine responds to
the password with a pleasant
chime, confirming that you've
input the correct numbers.
The keypad slides open to
reveal a piece of a tablet.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF机器对密码做出了回应，发出悦耳的铃声，确认你输入了正确的数字。
键盘滑开，露出了一块石板碎片。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe message engraved on
this tablet reads: ''This is for
Christopher, my dear friend
who I met in Prontera. To the
one who finds this, please seek
out the next piece of this tablet
in the city of thickest forest.''^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF石板上刻着一段话：“这是给克里斯托弗的，我在普隆德拉结识的挚友。找到这块石板的人，请前往‘森林最茂密的城市’，寻找下一块石板碎片。”^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe message is signed
by someone named Tyus.
It would be best to bring
this back to Sir Chilia'Tyus
and confirm that this was
made by his grandfather...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF署名是提乌斯。最好把它带回给奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士，确认这是否出自他祖父之手...^000000

scripts.text:
The machine responds to
the password with an abrupt,
screeching beep and the entire
machine shuts down. You'll have to try entering the password again.
scripts.translation: 机器发出一声刺耳的蜂鸣回应密码，随即彻底关闭。你得重新输入密码再试一次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh...
Forget it.

[{0}]
Uh oh...
Where did I put
the cogwheel that
Clanux Heffron gave me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟糕...克拉努克斯·赫夫伦给我的那个齿轮我放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, let me see
if I can enter the
right number this time...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，让我看看这次能不能输入正确的数字...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe machine responds to
the password with a pleasant
chime, confirming that you've
input the correct numbers.
The keypad slides open to
reveal a piece of a tablet.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF机器对密码做出回应，发出悦耳的铃声，确认你输入的数字正确。键盘滑开，露出一块石板碎片。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe message engraved on
this tablet reads: ''This is for
Christopher, my dear friend
who I met in Prontera. To the
one who finds this, please seek
out the next piece of this tablet
in the city of thickest forest.''^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF石板上刻着一段话：“这是给克里斯托弗的，我在普隆德拉结识的挚友。找到这块石板的人，请前往‘森林最茂密的城市’，寻找下一块石板碎片。”^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe message is signed
by someone named Tyus.
It would be best to bring

scripts.translation: ^3355FF署名是提乌斯。最好把它带回给奇利亚斯·提乌斯爵士，确认这是否出自他祖父之手...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The machine responds to
the password with an abrupt,
screeching beep and the entire
machine shuts down. You'll have to try entering the password again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
机器发出一声刺耳的蜂鸣回应密码，随即彻底关闭。你得重新输入密码再试一次。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's some sort of
strange looking machine
with a mysterious purpose.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一台外观奇怪的机器，用途不明。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请站住！
您携带的物品过多，背包空间不足，无法领取奖励。
请腾出一些背包空间后再来接受挑战。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey...
Hey you!
What are you
looking at?!
Get outta my
face, ya jerkwad.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
嘿...嘿，你！你在看什么？！别挡我的路，你这混蛋。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
What...?
You got something
to tell me or are you
just bein' a rude prick
and staring at me like
this is your turf?!
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
什么...？你有话要说，还是只是在这儿没礼貌地盯着我，仿佛这里是你的地盘？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but well...
Chilias'Tyus told me that
you might know something
about a piece of a tablet--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉...奇利亚斯·提乌斯说你可能知道一块石板碎片的事——

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
What? Oh, so Chilias'Tyus
is lookin for the gem too, eh?
Ooh, that's right. He wants to
seal its evil or something.
Yeah, yeah. That's a good
cause. Real noble and all...
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
什么？哦，奇利亚斯·提乌斯也在找宝石，是吧？对了，他想封印它的邪恶力量什么的。是啊，那是件好事，确实很高尚...

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Tell you what. The only reason
I want that gem is to sell it so I can pay off all my debts. But
if I sell you the clues I found, I'll get the zeny I need and the
gem will be in good hands too.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
我告诉你吧，我想要那颗宝石，只是想把它卖掉还清债务。不过，如果我把找到的线索卖给你，就能拿到需要的钱，而宝石也会落在可靠的人手里。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
So what do you say?
It's not a bad deal if
you think about it and
we might as well kill
two birds with one stone...
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
你觉得怎么样？仔细想想，这可不是一笔坏交易，我们不妨一石二鸟...

scripts.text: Alright, I'll buy your clues.
scripts.translation: 好的，我买你的线索

scripts.text: Why the hell should I pay you?!
scripts.translation: 我为什么要付钱给你？！

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh man, thanks a lot.
Alright, all I'm asking
for is 10,000 zeny. You get
my clues and I'll let you know
where I found 'em, in case
you can find something new.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
太感谢了！好吧，我只要10,000 Zeny。你买下线索后，我会告诉你它们的出处，看看你能不能找到新的线索。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
There you go!
Thanks for the cash~
(Now I won't have to
get my knees all broken!)
Oh, and let me mark your
Mini-Map for you real quick...
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
给你！谢谢你的钱~（这样我的膝盖就不用被人打断了！）哦，我这就帮你在小地图上标出位置...

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
You see this here?
It's where I found the
Skirt of Virgin I'm about
to give you. So check that
spot out and see if you find
anything new and interesting.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
看见这里了吗？这就是我找到那件少女的裙子的地方。去那里看看，说不定能发现新的线索。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Here you go, pal...
A Stone Heart, Green Herb,
some Grape Juice and one
clean and pure Skirt of Virgin.
If you got any more questions,
I guess you can ask me later~
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
给你，伙计...一颗石心、一株绿色药草、一瓶葡萄汁，还有一条干净的少女的裙子。还有问题的话，之后再来问我吧~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Whoa whoa...
But you don't got any room
in your inventory to hold
what I wanna give you. It'd
probably be best to stash your
stuff in Kafra Storage, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
哇哦...但你的背包没有足够空间装下我要给你的东西。最好把一些东西存进卡普拉仓库，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh hey...
You don't got the zeny.
Sorry pal, but I've really got
to pay my debts somehow.
I don't know if I'm allowed
to really talk about it...
^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
哦，嘿...你没有 Zeny。抱歉，伙计，但我得想办法还债。我不知道自己能不能把这事说出来...^333333*呜呜*^000000

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Why the hell should you
pay me?! Hey, aren't you
looking for the gem to help
the world? Well, I happen to
be a little part of this world,
so why don't you help me first?
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
你为什么要付钱给我？！嘿，你不是想找到宝石来拯救世界吗？我也是这个世界的一份子，为什么不能先帮帮我？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Man, you might not
know it, but the money
you give me will save
a life. My own! Dude, how
can you be so insensitive?
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
伙计，你可能不知道，但你给我的钱能救一条命。就是我自己的！你怎么能这么无情？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
You forgot where I told
you to look for more clues?
Eh, I'll let you know once
again, sure. Keep your eye
on your Mini-Map, got it?
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
忘了我告诉你去哪里找更多线索了吗？好吧，我再告诉你一次。看好你的小地图，知道了吗？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Alright...
Good luck out there.
I really hope you can
keep the gem out of the
wrong hands. Of course, I was gonna just sell it, but...
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
好吧...祝你好运。我真希望你能让宝石不落入坏人手中。当然，我本来打算把它卖掉，不过...

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
You've been to the
first location? Good.
Okay, now look over here.
Check your Mini-Map to
see where I found that
Stone Heart, got it?
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
你去过第一个地点了？很好。来，看看这里。检查你的小地图，看看我在哪里找到那颗石心，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Alright, here's where
I found that Green Herb.
You know you can use that
to counter poison, right?
Check that place to see if
there's anything I missed.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
好，这里就是我找到绿色药草的地方。你知道它能解毒，对吧？去那里看看有没有我漏掉的东西。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Okay, here's the last
place you should double
check, the place where
I nabbed that Grape
Juice. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
好，这是最后一个你该去仔细查看的地方，也就是我拿到那瓶葡萄汁的地方。祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh, you need some help
in figuring out the clues?
Heh. Alright, let's see.
You want me to help
you in making sense of
this weird riddle?
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
哦，你需要帮忙解读这些线索吗？嘿，好吧，让我看看。你想让我帮你弄明白这个奇怪的谜题吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please!
scripts.translation: 好的，请给我！

scripts.text: No, thanks~
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Alright now. All those
messages said stuff about
one sized clothing, dried
fish and green herbs, wine...
Huh. It doesn't make sense.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
好吧。这些留言都提到了均码衣物、干鱼、绿色药草和葡萄酒...嗯，真让人摸不着头脑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?
I could have
told you that!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么...？
这我早就能告诉你了！

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Wait, wait.
Let's mark all the
clue locations again
on your Mini-Map.
Okay, we've got four
dots around Payon.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
等等，等等。我们再在你的小地图上标出所有线索的位置。好了，斐扬周围有四个点。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Alright, now if
I connect and intersect
all the lines, there's
a point in the middle.
Why don't you check
this middle point, eh?
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
现在，把所有线索点连起来并延长，交点就在中间。不妨去那里看看？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Now, this location
is a house, and I know
it's pretty random, but
it's all we got. Heck,
all these clues make
less sense than this!
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
这个地点是一栋房子。我知道这听起来很随意，但我们就只有这些线索了。天哪，其他线索比这还不靠谱！

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh yeah?
Well listen, I dunno,
but this looks to be one
of those situations where
two heads are better than one.
I think we oughta team up~
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
哦，是吗？听着，我也不太确定，不过这看起来像是那种两人合作胜过单打独斗的情况。我觉得咱们还是组队吧~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey, how's it goin'
looking for that one
piece of the tablet?
It's a lot of trouble,
but I guess that's the
case with all treasure.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
嘿，那块石板碎片找得怎么样了？这事确实麻烦，不过我想寻宝总得费点劲。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh, so all of those
items came in handy?
I don't believe it! So
this puzzle actually
makes sense?! So
what'd the slab say?
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
哦，原来那些东西都派上用场了？真不敢相信！所以这谜题真的有道理？！那石板上写了什么？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
''Compassionate one?''
Oh hey, there's a giant
stone statue over in the
Archer Village that fits
that description perfectly!
You should check it out.
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
“慈悲之人”？弓箭手村有尊巨大的石像，完全符合这个描述！你去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey, you really ought
to check out the huge
stone statue over in the
Archer Village. Now that
I think about it, it's the
perfect hiding place!
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
嘿，你真该去看看弓箭手村那尊巨大的石像。现在想想，那简直是绝佳的藏匿地点！

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey, this is great!
You actually found the
next piece of the tablet!
You better take this back
to Chilias'Tyus right now~
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
嘿，太棒了！你真的找到了下一块石板碎片！快把它带回给奇利亚斯·提乌斯吧~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh. And um, thanks
for being willing to pay
me in cash for all those
little bitty clues. I won't
forget your help, pal~
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
哦，对了，嗯，谢谢你愿意花钱买我那些零零碎碎的线索。我不会忘记你的帮助，伙计~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey, be careful if
you manage to find that
Hellion's gem. I dunno if
it's true, but maybe old
Tyus was right. Maybe it
does hold a wicked power...
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
嘿，要是你真找到海利翁之眼，可得小心。我不知道这是真是假，但也许老提乌斯说得没错。它或许真蕴含着邪恶力量...

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Life sure is a lot
less tense without
having debt to worry
about. I could get
real used to this...
scripts.translation:
[格鲁特·图科克]
不用再为债务操心，生活确实轻松多了。我都快习惯这种日子了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, this is where
Grout'he told me to look.
Ooh, there's something
written on the ceiling. Um,
let's see... ''This garment
is one size fits all.''
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这就是格鲁特·图科克告诉我去找的地方。噢，天花板上有字。让我看看...“这件衣服是均码的。”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's it...?
Hopefully this will
make more sense once
I find more clues. I hope.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就这样...？希望找到更多线索后，这件事能变得更有意义。希望如此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, this is the place
that Grout'he told me about.
Let's see, there's an engraving
here that says, ''I used to pray for peaceful days here.'' Okay.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这就是格鲁特·图科克告诉我的地方。这里刻着：“我曾在这里祈求平静的日子。”好吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Man...
This better not be
one of those puzzles
that looks easy once
I get the answer. Well,
if I ever get it, that is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...这最好不是那种一旦知道答案就显得很简单的谜题。前提是我能解出来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... Dried fish all
around me. This is getting
to be nonsense. Let's see,
this message says, ''Green
Herbs are very useful for
getting rid of fish smells.''
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
周围全是干鱼。这越来越荒唐了。让我看看，这条留言写着：“绿色药草能有效去除鱼腥味。”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got it...!
Whoever made up
these clues must be
some sort of crazy man!
It's the only explanation!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了...！想出这些线索的人一定是个疯子！这是唯一的解释！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, the last
place I have to check.
It's a big old vat with a
message here too. Now
let me see, there should
be a message here too. Ah--!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，这是最后一个要检查的地方。这里有个大旧桶，上面也有留言。让我看看...应该就在这里。啊——！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This says, ''What will it be?
Wine or Grape Juice? Oh,
but I much prefer wine.'' Okay,
what does this have to do with
that Hellion's gem? Weird...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
上面写着：“你会选什么？葡萄酒还是葡萄汁？哦，不过我更喜欢葡萄酒。”这和海利翁之眼有什么关系？真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Am I missing something?
I think I really need help in
figuring this out. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是不是漏掉了什么？我真的需要别人帮忙解开这个谜题。嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, the floor around
here doesn't seem very
solid. Maybe there's
something underneath?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，这里的地板看起来不太结实。下面会不会藏着什么？

scripts.text: Just check the floor.
scripts.translation: 检查地板

scripts.text: Dig through the dust.
scripts.translation: 拨开灰尘

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine the floor,
but are unable to find
anything that resembles
a clue to the location
of the Hellion's gem
or a tablet piece.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你检查了地板，却没找到任何与海利翁之眼位置或石板碎片有关的线索。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh man, there's
so much dust! What
can I do about all of
this nasty dirt in the air?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪，灰尘真多！空气里全是讨厌的尘土，我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, there are all these
clues Grout'he found. It sucks,
but I'll use this Grape Juice
to sort of keep this dust from
kicking up. And if I put my morals^FFFFFFa^000000 on hold, I'll cover my face...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里有格鲁特·图科克找到的所有线索。真糟，不过我可以用葡萄汁压住扬起的灰尘。如果我暂时把道德^FFFFFF底线^000000放一边，就用衣服遮住脸...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...With this Skirt of Virgin.
Oh, and I can use this Stone
Heart to prop any floor boards
I tilt while I look underneath
this floor. Oh hey! I found it!
It's... It's another clue!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...就用这条少女的裙子。哦，我还可以用石心撑住撬起的地板，好查看下面。嘿！找到了！这是...另一条线索！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, wait...
I can't read the
engraving on this
stone slab, it's way
too old. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...我读不懂这块石板上的刻字，它太古老了。让我看看...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cover the surface
of the slab and begin
to rub a Green Herb over
it. Fortunately, the juice from
the Green Herb makes the
engraving appear more clearly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你用绿色药草在石板表面来回擦拭。幸运的是，药草汁液让刻字显现得更加清楚。^000000

scripts.text:
[Stone Engraving]
^4D4DFF''This has been entrusted to
the care of the compassionate
one so that my friends may
find peace. To he who finds
this, remember that avarice
knows no bounds. --Tyus.''^000000
scripts.translation:
[石刻]
^4D4DFF“这件东西托付给慈悲之人保管，好让我的朋友们得以安息。找到它的人，请记住：贪婪没有止境。——提乌斯”^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where did I leave
all that stuff I got from
Grout'he? Let's see,
there was a Green Herb,
a Stone Heart, Grape Juice
and one Skirt of Virgin...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把从格鲁特·图科克那里拿到的东西放在哪里了？让我看看...一株绿色药草、一块石心、一瓶葡萄汁，还有一条少女的裙子...

scripts.text:
[Stone Engraving]
^4D4DFF''This has been entrusted to
the care of the compassionate
one so that my friends may
find peace. To he who finds
this, remember that avarice
knows no bounds. --Tyus.''^000000
scripts.translation:
[石刻]
^4D4DFF“这件东西托付给慈悲之人保管，好让我的朋友们得以安息。找到它的人，请记住：贪婪没有止境。——提乌斯”^000000

scripts.text:
[Stone Engraving]
^4D4DFF''This has been entrusted to
the care of the compassionate
one so that my friends may
find peace. To he who finds
this, remember that avarice
knows no bounds. --Tyus.''^000000
scripts.translation:
[石刻]
^4D4DFF“这件东西托付给慈悲之人保管，好让我的朋友们得以安息。找到它的人，请记住：贪婪没有止境。——提乌斯”^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请站住！
您携带的物品过多，背包空间不足，无法领取奖励。
请腾出一些背包空间后再来接受挑战。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, here's a huge
stone statue. This
must be what Grout'he
was telling me about.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，这里有一尊巨大的石像。
这一定是格鲁特·图科克告诉我的那个。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
^4d4dffYou must...
You must be...^000000
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
^4d4dff你...
你一定是...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the--?
There's a voice
inside my head!
And it's not even mine!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
搞什么——？我的脑海里有个声音！而且那根本不是我的声音！

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
You who have come
for the Tablet Piece,
I shall judge whether
or not you are worthy.
Answer this one question.
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
为了石板碎片而来的人，我将审判你是否配得上它。回答我的问题。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
You are in a situation
in which you will die,
but if you cause the death
of another person, you will
surely save yourself. So...
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
你正处于必死的境地，但如果杀死另一个人，就能确保自己活下来。那么...你会怎么做？

scripts.text: I will kill to survive.
scripts.translation: 我会杀人求生

scripts.text: I have no choice, but to die.
scripts.translation: 我别无选择，只能赴死

scripts.text: I won't kill, but I'll find a way to live!
scripts.translation: 我不杀人，但我会想办法活下去！

scripts.text: I'll ask that person if it's okay to kill him.
scripts.translation: 我会问那个人，是否愿意让我杀了他。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
There is a primal truth
to your answer. However...
You have chosen poorly.
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
你的回答揭示了一个根本的真理。不过...你选错了。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
There is a kindness and
compassion in your answer
that is indeed rare. However,
where is the respect for your
own life? If you are that willing to throw it away, you are no hero.
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
你的回答体现了难得的仁慈与同情。不过，你又有多珍惜自己的生命？如果你如此轻易地舍弃它，就算不上英雄。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
Yes. Love for all life,
including your own, is
a trait that all true heroes
must have. You have chosen...
Wisely. Please, take this into
your capable hands, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
没错。珍视一切生命，包括自己的生命，才是真正的英雄应有的品格。你做出了...明智的选择。冒险者，请妥善保管这件东西。

scripts.text:
^3355FFA stone slab at the foot
of the statue slides open,
revealing a piece of the
tablet that will lead you
to the Hellion's gem.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雕像脚下的石板滑开，露出一块能指引你找到海利翁之眼的石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
The veneer of honesty in
your answer is surpassed by
your own cowardice. You have
chosen extremely poorly...
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
你回答中那点虚伪的诚实，远远不及你表现出的怯懦。你选得糟透了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe piece of tablet
that you have is shining
with light as if in response
to something in the area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你手中的石板碎片正闪烁着光芒，仿佛是对周围某种事物的回应。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请站住！
您携带的物品过多，背包空间不足，无法领取奖励。
请腾出一些背包空间后再来接受挑战。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Hm? Oh, pardon me.
I didn't notice you. I was
far too occupied thinking
deep important thoughts
that your puny little mind
couldn't possibly fathom.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
嗯？啊，失礼了，我没注意到你。我刚才正沉浸在深奥重要的思考中，你那小脑袋瓜恐怕无法理解。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
That...
That eerie glow...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
那...那诡异的光芒...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
You! Identify yourself
and explain how you came
about to get those tablet
pieces! Now answer me!
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
你！报上名来，并解释你是如何得到那些石板碎片的！现在回答我！

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Ah, forgive me. You're
helping Chilias, are you?
I see. So you must be here
to seek my help in finding
the final piece, am I correct?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
啊，请原谅。你是在帮助奇利亚斯，对吧？我明白了。那你一定是来找我帮忙寻找最后一块碎片的，对吗？

scripts.text: Shut up, I know you have it, so give it!
scripts.translation: 闭嘴，我知道你有，快给我！

scripts.text: Yes, please help me.
scripts.translation: 是的，请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Such insolence!
Huh. I suppose Chilias
may have misjudged you
when he entrusted you with
this important mission. Huh.
A reevaluation is in order...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
真是无礼！哼，奇利亚斯把这项重要任务托付给你，看来是看走眼了。嗯...我得重新评估一下...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Of course, in the
interest of mankind,
I shall help you. But first,
I have a favor to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
当然，为了人类的利益，我会帮助你。
但首先，我有件事想请你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
My student in the Geffen
Tower has not reported back to
me about his research project,
so I would like for you to find
him and retrieve the report
for me. Not a big deal, right?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
我在吉芬塔里的学生还没有向我汇报研究项目，所以想请你找到他，并把报告拿给我。这不是什么大事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
The title of his report
should be, ''^4D4DFFMonster Life
in the Geffen Area^000000,'' so
please remember that.
Ah, and my student's
name is Enoz.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
他的报告标题应该是“^4D4DFF吉芬地区的魔物生态^000000”，请记住这一点。啊，对了，我的学生名叫埃诺兹。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Please bring me the
report entitled, ''^4D4DFFMonster
Life in the Geffen Area^000000,''
from my student Enoz in
the Geffen Tower. Thank
you, I appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
请从我在吉芬塔里的学生埃诺兹那里，把标题为“^4D4DFF吉芬地区的魔物生态^000000”的报告带给我。谢谢，我很感激你的帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Oh dear me...
I'm unfathomably thirsty...
There's no way I can do any
serious thinking with such
a dry, parched throat...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
^333333*咳咳*^000000天哪...我渴得厉害...喉咙干得发涩，根本没法认真思考...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Oh, a White Potion?
Yes, may I please have
one? Ahh, most refreshing~
You may not be such a bad
person after all! Now shall I help you find that tablet piece?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
哦，白色药水？是的，能给我一瓶吗？啊，真清爽~看来你也不是什么坏人嘛！现在我可以帮你找那块石板碎片了吧？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Of course, in the
interest of mankind,
I shall help you. But first,
I have a favor to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
当然，为了人类的利益，我会帮助你。
但首先，我有件事想请你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
My student in the Geffen
Tower has not reported back to
me about his research project,
so I would like for you to find
him and retrieve the report
for me. Not a big deal, right?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
我在吉芬中央塔的学生还没有向我汇报他的研究项目，所以我想请你找到他，并把报告拿给我。
这不是什么大事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
The title of his report
should be, ''^4D4DFFMonster Life
in the Geffen Area^000000,'' so
please remember that.
Ah, and my student's
name is Enoz.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
他的报告标题应该是“^4D4DFF吉芬地区的魔物生态^000000”，请务必记住这一点。
啊，对了，我的学生名叫埃诺兹。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Oh...! Still so...
Exasperatingly thirsty!
If I only had something
cool, refreshing and with
a high restorative value
to quench this thirst!
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
哦...还是这么...渴得让人心烦！要是有点清凉解渴、又能补充体力的东西就好了！

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Please bring me the
report entitled, ''^4D4DFFMonster
Life in the Geffen Area^000000,''
from my student Enoz in
the Geffen Tower. Thank
you, I appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
请从吉芬中央塔的我的学生埃诺兹那里，把标题为“^4D4DFF吉芬地区的魔物生态^000000”的报告带给我。
谢谢，我很感激你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Hm? What's that strange
expression on your face?
Prank? Oh please. Such
chicanery is beneath me...
But even if I did play a joke, believe me. It builds character.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
嗯？你脸上那奇怪的表情是怎么回事？恶作剧？拜托，这种诡计可有失我的身份...不过就算我真的开了玩笑，也请相信我。这能磨练性格。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
First and foremost,
I want to test you to see
if you are worthy of this
tablet piece. I want to see
for myself if you are a person
of honor. Someone of character.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
首先，我想测试你是否配得上这块石板碎片。我想亲自确认你是个有操守、有品格的人。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Oh yes, I accidentally
took this Master Science
Reference Book from Enoz,
so would you please return it
to him for me? Oh, and please
bring back 1 Blue Gemstone.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
哦，对了，我不小心从埃诺兹那里拿走了这本《大师科学参考书》，能请你帮我还给他吗？另外，请带回1颗蓝色魔力矿石。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received the
incredibly heavy tome,
the Master Science
Reference Book.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你获得了那本极其沉重的《大师科学参考书》。^000000

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Please deliver the Master
Science Reference Book to
Enoz, and come back to me
with 1 Blue Gemstone.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
请把《大师科学参考书》交给埃诺兹，然后带着1颗蓝色魔力矿石回来见我。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Thank you. You've
brought the book to Enoz
and delivered a Gemstone
to me as I've asked. Now,
there is one final test...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
谢谢。你已经把书交给了埃诺兹，也按我的要求把宝石原石带给了我。现在还有最后一项测试...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Answer this question.
Where is the abode of the
departed souls with a shining
silver roof that is mentioned
in the third part of the ballad
of Grimnir? Well, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
回答我：格林尼尔歌谣第三部分中提到的、银色屋顶闪耀的逝者居所，究竟在哪里？冒险者，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Ah, well met, well met.
You are as well learned as
you are brave. As promised,
you may have this piece of
the tablet, which I've already found. The clues were too simple...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
啊，幸会，幸会。你既勇敢又博学。如我所承诺，这块我已经找到的石板碎片就交给你。线索实在太简单了...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Please send my regards
to my dear friend, Chilias,
who has dedicated his life
to sealing the evil within
the Hellion's gem.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
请代我向亲爱的朋友奇利亚斯问好。他毕生都在努力封印海利翁之眼中的邪恶。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Bwahahaah! Only
a superior mind could
know the answer to such
a question! Go forth and
learn the answer, else
I cannot help you, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
哇哈哈！只有卓越的智慧才能答出这样的问题！去寻找答案吧，否则我帮不了你，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Ah, I've heard that
Enoz received the Master
Science Reference Book
from you. But did you remember
to bring me a Blue Gemstone?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
啊，我听说埃诺兹已经从你那里收到了《大师科学参考书》。
但是，你记得给我带蓝色魔力矿石吗？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Hm. You should visit
Chilias and determine
your next course of action,
now that you have all four
of the pieces of the tablet.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
嗯，既然你已经集齐了四块石板碎片，就去找奇利亚斯，商量下一步行动吧。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Hm? Did you need
me to combine all four
pieces of the tablet and
make it whole again? Oh.
All this time I thought you
knew how to do it. Alright.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
嗯？你是要我把四块石板碎片拼起来，恢复石板原状吗？哦，我一直以为你知道怎么做。好吧。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
As a matter of fact,
I was planning on using
the Blue Gemstone you gave
me to do this. But since you
never really asked... In any
case, let me concentrate.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
事实上，我本打算用你给我的蓝色魔力矿石来拼合石板。不过你一直没开口要求...无论如何，让我集中精神。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Shadows remembered by time.
Help me retrieve the forgotten
stories that have been scattered in the wind. Right here. Right now.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
被时间铭记的阴影。帮我找回那些散落在风中的遗忘故事。就在此刻，就在此地。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
...
Okay...
That was tough.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
...
好吧...真是费劲。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
That was tough
complete tablet.
Please bring this
safely back to Chilias.
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
总算拼好了这块石板。请把它安全地带回给奇利亚斯。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Wait, take a look!
There's a map on the back
of the tablet. Although the gem
is already embedded within the
tablet, who knows where this map may lead? Perhaps Hellion Revenant?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
等等，快看！石板背面有张地图。虽然宝石已经镶在石板里了，但谁知道地图会指向哪里？也许是暗黑祭司所在之处？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
I don't know if Chilias
told you, but the name of
the monster that guards and
follows this gem is Hellion
Revenant. But why mark its
location on this tablet?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
奇利亚斯可能没告诉你，守护并追随这颗宝石的魔物名叫暗黑祭司。不过，为什么要在石板上标出它的位置呢？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Well, it will be dangerous, but
I'm sure that you're strong enough to confront this monster. I believe
it was the wish of this tablet's creator for someone to defeat
the Hellion Revenant...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
此行或许很危险，但我相信你有足够的实力对付这只魔物。我想，石板的制作者一定希望有人能击败暗黑祭司...

scripts.text: Alright, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 没问题，交给我吧！

scripts.text: I better get this tablet to Chilias...
scripts.translation: 我还是先把石板交给奇利亚斯吧

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Well, I'm almost certain
this map will lead you to
Hellion Revenant. Let me
warp you to the location
marked on the tablet's map...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
我几乎可以肯定，这张地图会把你引向暗黑祭司。让我把你传送到石板地图上标记的位置...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Yes, that's true.
Chilias has been waiting
his whole life to seal this
gem. Plus, who knows what
may happen while it is in
your possession?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
没错。奇利亚斯毕生都在等待封印这颗宝石的机会。再说，它现在在你手里，谁知道会发生什么？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
So, were you able
to deliver the tablet
and the Hellion's gem to
Chilias safely? I hope so...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
那么，你把石板和海利翁之眼安全交给奇利亚斯了吗？希望一切顺利...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
So, were you able
to deliver the tablet
and the Hellion's gem to
Chilias safely? Ah, and
how has my friend been?
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
那么，你把石板和海利翁之眼安全交给奇利亚斯了吗？啊，对了，我那位朋友近来可好？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Heh heh~
Enoz must be
panicking right
about now. Oh,
students are always
good for a laugh...
scripts.translation:
[威尔什云]
嘿嘿~
埃诺兹现在肯定急得团团转吧。唉，学生总能让我寻开心...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe piece of tablet
that you have is shining
with light as if in response
to something in the area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你手中的石板碎片正闪烁着光芒，仿佛是对周围某种事物的回应。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
It's gone, it's gone!
Where the hell did it go?!
Oh man, who could have
taken it? Wait, was it... You?!
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
不见了，不见了！到底去哪儿了？！天哪，谁拿走了？等等，是你吗？！

scripts.text: Actually, Welshyun sent me.
scripts.translation: 其实是威尔什云派我来的。

scripts.text: No way man, don't go nuts.
scripts.translation: 不可能，伙计，别激动。

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
My mentor, Welshyun?
Huh. Is there a report
I haven't submitted to him
yet? So what was it called?
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
我的师父，威尔什云？
嗯。
难道还有我没向他提交的报告？
那叫什么名字来着？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
''Monster Life in
the Geffen Area?''
Oh no. My mentor took
that three days ago!
Is he still up to his
old tricks again?
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
“吉芬地区的魔物生态”？糟糕，我师父三天前就拿走了！他是不是又在耍老把戏？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Awww nuts!
Where the heck is
my Master Science
Reference Book? 
It was right here
three days ago...
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
啊，该死！我的《大师科学参考书》到底去哪儿了？三天前明明还在这里...

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
{0}?
I haven't completed
any research related
to that subject. Or did I?
Anyway, I need the exact
name of the report you want!
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
{0}？我没做过相关主题的研究...还是说我做过？总之，你要哪份报告，请告诉我准确的标题！

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Nuts?! Oh, you wanna
see crazy, is that it?! You
wanna see insaaaane?!
Cuz I'll go freakin' medieval
if you keep bothering me!!
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
该死？哦，你想看看什么叫疯狂，是吗？！你想见识真正的疯癫？！你再来烦我，我就跟你急！！

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
My mentor Welshyun's
been playing jokes again,
so you better go talk to him.
Damn. Where is that Master
Science Reference Book?
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
我的师父威尔什云又在恶作剧了，你最好去和他谈谈。
该死。
那本《大师科学参考书》到底去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Oh hey, I remember you~
So did my mentor send you
to me again for some reason?
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
哦，嘿，我记得你~我师父又因为某种原因把你派来找我了吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cautiously hand Enoz the
Master Science Reference Book.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你小心翼翼地将《大师科学参考书》递给埃诺兹。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Yes! Oh yes!
This is the book
I lost three days
ago! Thanks so much!
Now I can finally finish
this research project that--
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
是的！没错！这就是我三天前弄丢的那本书！太感谢你了！现在我终于能完成这个研究项目——

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Wait, the page I really
need is missing! And there's
some sort of note... Umm...
^333333''Enoz, I think this page
is worth at least one Apple
Juice. Right? --Welshyun.''^000000
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
等等，我真正需要的那一页不见了！还有张便条...嗯...^333333“埃诺兹，我觉得这一页至少值一瓶苹果汁，对吧？——威尔什云。”^000000

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
NOooOOoOo!
Not agaaaaain!
Why is he always
playing these pranks?!
Apple Juice! I need
some Apple Juice!
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
不——！不要再来一次了！他为什么总爱搞这些恶作剧？！苹果汁！我得弄点苹果汁！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like it's time
to get 1 Blue Gemstone,
and then bring it back
to Welshyun the Sage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看来是时候去弄1颗蓝色魔力矿石，然后把它带回给贤者威尔什云了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Gone! It's gone!
Where did the book
I really need go to?
Oh no oh no oh no oh no!
Waaaaaah, I'm gonna cry!
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
不见了！那本我真正需要的书去哪儿了？天哪天哪天哪天哪！哇，我要哭了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAmongst the wild bushes
and overgrown grass, you
see a large rock slab that
resembles a door. As you
come closer, you can see a
groove on the rock's surface.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在杂草丛生的灌木丛中，你看到一块巨大的岩石板，看起来像一扇门。走近后，你发现岩石表面有一道凹槽。^000000

scripts.text: Insert the Tablet.
scripts.translation: 插入石板

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the tablet into
the rock's groove and the
Hellion's gem begins to hum
and glow. The rock slides open,
revealing an engraved message
on the ground for you to read.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将石板插入岩石的凹槽中，海利翁之眼开始嗡嗡作响并发光。岩石滑开，露出刻在地面上的文字。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFF''To you who have found this
place, I reveal the truth about
the Hellion Revenant. It was
never a devil, like we believed, but a human being, slowly
corrupted by the darkness
of the Hellion's gem.''^000000
scripts.translation: ^4D4DFF“致发现此地的人，我要揭示暗黑祭司的真相。它从来不是我们以为的恶魔，而是一个逐渐被海利翁之眼的黑暗腐蚀的人类。”^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFF''I learned this horrible
truth too late. Already,
I can feel the darkness
welling up within me.
It is all I can do to trap
myself in this chamber
before I lose all reason.''^000000
scripts.translation: ^4D4DFF“我得知这个可怕的真相时，为时已晚。如今，我已感到黑暗在体内涌动。我只能趁自己还没有彻底失去理智前，把自己困在这间密室里。”^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFF''I failed and it's too
late for me, but I hope
someone in the future
can seal the Hellion gem's
dark power. And I hope that
someone will grant me the
sweet release I crave...''^000000
scripts.translation: ^4D4DFF“我失败了，对我来说已经太迟。但我希望未来有人能封印海利翁之眼的黑暗力量，也希望有人能赐予我所渴望的解脱...”^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFF''Brave hero, I beg of
you. Please kill me and
bring salvation to my soul.
Please release me so that
I can finally join my friends.
^FFFFFF_^000000
^FFFFFFOOOOOOOOOOO^4D4DFF-Tyus''^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF“勇敢的英雄，我恳求你。请杀了我，拯救我的灵魂。请释放我，让我终于能与朋友团聚。
^FFFFFF_^000000
^FFFFFFOOOOOOOOOOO^4D4DFF-提乌斯”^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou do nothing.
And nothing happens.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你什么也没做。
然后什么也没发生。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe tablet in your
hands begins to shine
with light, responding
to something in the area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你手中的石板开始发光，似乎在回应周围某种东西。^000000
